definitions: A powdery white or colored crust of soluble salts, often seen on the surface of masonry or concrete.
The process of a substance losing water of crystallization and becoming a powder.
The state or period of flowering; a blossoming.
A rash or eruption on the skin.
examples: The efflorescence on the brick wall was quite noticeable.
The chemist observed the efflorescence of the salt.
The efflorescence of culture in the Renaissance.
The doctor noted the efflorescence on the patient's arm.
